`abstract class StateGuardContractSuite`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.test.contract` · **Module:** `tool-testkit` · **Source:** [StateGuardContractSuite.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/testkit/src/main/java/dev/joid/test/contract/StateGuardContractSuite.java)

The contract tests of a render bridge that shares its graphics context with a host: every frame must look the same and give the host its state back, whatever the host left set.

## Description

Each test draws a frame on a clean state, sets one [`StateTrap`](/reference/testing/statetrap/), draws the frame again and compares both, pixel for pixel; it also checks the state of the host before, during and after a drawing of the host.
A trap that the context lacks is skipped.

- [The suites](/build/testing-a-backend/#the-suites)
- [Check the guard](/build/embedding-in-a-host/#check-the-guard)
